info.title: Centralised Expense & Refund Management System
info.description: Enterprise Centralised Expense & Refund Management System (CRS) API

post.description:
Register a new user account.
If this is the first user in the database, promote to ADMIN automatically.

Authenticate with email and password.
Returns short-lived JWT access token and rotating refresh token.

Exchange valid refresh token for a new access token and a new rotated refresh token.
The old refresh token is revoked immediately.

get.description: Return the profile of the currently authenticated user

List expenses:
- Employees see only their own expenses.
- Reviewers, Finance, and Admins can view all company expenses.

Create a new expense claim.
Can be created as DRAFT or directly SUBMITTED.

parameters.name: submit_now

schema.title: Submit Now

parameters.description: Directly transition to SUBMITTED upon creation

get.description: Retrieve details of a single expense claim

patch.description: Edit a claim while in DRAFT or CHANGES_REQUESTED status

delete.description: Delete an unsubmitted DRAFT expense claim

post.description: Submit a DRAFT or CHANGES_REQUESTED expense claim for approval

get.description:
List expense claims awaiting approval matching the reviewer's permission level:
- REVIEWER: Tier-1 pending claims (status SUBMITTED, current_approval_tier 0)
- FINANCE: Tier-2 secondary approval claims (status UNDER_REVIEW, current_approval_tier 1)
- ADMIN: All pending claims across Tier 1 and Tier 2

schema.title: Response List Pending Approvals Api V1 Approvals Pending Get

post.description:
Execute approval decision on an expense claim:
- APPROVE: Advances tier or completes approval
- REJECT: Terminally rejects claim
- CHANGES_REQUESTED: Sends claim back to employee for modification

get.description: List all reimbursement transactions (Finance and Admin only)

schema.title: Response List Reimbursements Api V1 Reimbursements Get

post.description:
